question: What must an Express Entry employment / reference letter contain?

prose: An Express Entry employment reference letter must be an official document printed on company letterhead and must include the applicant's name, company contact information (address, telephone number, and email address), and signatory details (name, title, and signature of the immediate supervisor or personnel officer). It must indicate all positions held and specify job title, duties and responsibilities, job status, dates worked, weekly work hours, and annual salary plus benefits. Upon evaluation of the submitted document, it is determined to be defective because the listed duties and responsibilities are copied verbatim from NOC lead statements rather than providing tailored job duties.
